CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_student_profile(_target_user_id uuid, _org_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    _target_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND _org_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
      WHERE user_id = _target_user_id
        AND role IN ('admin', 'organization', 'company', 'sales_manager')
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.org_staff
      WHERE user_id = _target_user_id
        AND organization_id = _org_id
        AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
    );
$function$

functions.arguments: p_org uuid, p_feature text, p_learner uuid, p_course uuid, p_source text, p_key text, p_when timestamp with time zone, p_evidence text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_bytes bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.postpaid_append_event(p_org uuid, p_feature text, p_learner uuid, p_course uuid, p_source text, p_key text, p_when timestamp with time zone, p_evidence text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_bytes bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE inserted integer;
BEGIN
 -- Platform-owned instructions (for example the welcome course) are not
 -- customer training. Check at capture time; later deletion/reclassification
 -- must not erase an already recorded legitimate training event.
 IF p_feature='study' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.courses WHERE id=p_course AND organization_id=p_org AND system_key IS NULL) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_billing_agreements WHERE organization_id=p_org
 AND effective_from<=(p_when AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>(p_when AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date)) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.postpaid_usage_events(organization_id,feature,learner_id,course_id,occurred_at,month_start,source_table,source_key,evidence,bytes,recorded_by)
 VALUES(p_org,p_feature,p_learner,p_course,p_when,date_trunc('month',p_when AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date,p_source,p_key,p_evidence,p_bytes,auth.uid())
 ON CONFLICT(organization_id,source_table,source_key,month_start) DO NOTHING;
 GET DIAGNOSTICS inserted=ROW_COUNT; RETURN inserted>0;
END $function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_org uuid, p_feature text, p_learner uuid, p_course uuid, p_source text, p_key text, p_when timestamp with time zone, p_evidence text, p_bytes bigint

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.postpaid_immutable_record()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Postpaid usage and confirmation evidence are immutable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.postpaid_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND public.has_role('admin'::public.app_role,auth.uid())
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_revocations WHERE user_id=auth.uid());
$function$
